tab.label: Travel
tab.description: Locations offered in the From, To and Destination fields of a travel lead (From / To can also be imported from CSV below). Services and their forms are managed on the Services & Forms page.

fields.label: From Locations
fields.helpText: Origins offered in the From field of a travel lead.

fields.label: To Locations
fields.helpText: Arrival points offered in the To field of a travel lead.

fields.label: Destinations
fields.helpText: Destinations offered on every travel lead.

fields.label: Nationalities
fields.helpText: Offered in the Nationality field of a traveller. Passport OCR picks the matching one (IND → Indian).

fields.label: Traveller Relations
fields.helpText: Offered in the Relation field of a traveller (how the traveller is related to the lead).

fields.label: Lead is ready when every required service is Complete
fields.helpText: Off: one Complete service is enough. A ready lead can get an opportunity and moves to Qualified (see CRM Settings → Qualification Match).

fields.label: Travellers needed before a lead is ready
fields.helpText: How many travellers the lead must have.

fields.label: Lead is ready only after availability is checked
fields.helpText: On: every Complete requirement also needs a current (not expired) Available, Held or On Request availability check before the lead is ready.

fields.label: Availability check: days a quote stays valid
fields.helpText: Pre-fills "Valid until" in the Check availability dialog (the agent can change it).

fields.label: Quotation: inclusions
fields.helpText: Printed on every travel quotation. One item per line.

fields.label: Quotation: exclusions
fields.helpText: Printed on every travel quotation. One item per line.

fields.label: Opportunities start from a lead
fields.helpText: On: a new opportunity must be linked to a travel lead (the Client option is hidden and the server refuses one without a lead).

fields.label: Opportunity: expected close (days before the trip)
fields.helpText: Expected close date = travel start date minus these days (never before tomorrow; no start date: today + 14 days).

fields.label: Quotation: valid till the earliest supplier hold
fields.helpText: On: "Valid till" starts at the earliest Held availability among the quoted services. Off, or without holds: today + the days below.

fields.label: Quotation: days a quotation stays valid
Quotation: show price per person
fields.helpText: Grand total ÷ the quotation's travellers, shown with the totals.

fields.label: Services & Requirement Forms
fields.helpText: Edited on the Services & Forms page.

fields.label: Aadhaar number storage
fields.helpText: Indian rules limit keeping full Aadhaar numbers. Keep the full number only if your process really needs it.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.helpText: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Kolkata or Asia/Dubai. Decides "today" for passport expiry and age checks (and the end of a day for availability holds).

fields.label: Booking number prefix
fields.helpText: Booking numbers are <prefix>-0001, -0002 … (letters, digits and "-").

fields.label: Hotel voucher terms
fields.default: Check-in and check-out times as per hotel policy. Please carry a government photo ID for every guest.
fields.helpText: Printed at the bottom of every hotel voucher.

fields.label: Transport voucher terms
fields.default: Please be at the pick-up point on time. Waiting beyond 30 minutes may be charged by the operator.
fields.helpText: Printed at the bottom of every transport voucher.

fields.label: Excursion voucher terms
fields.default: Timings may change with weather and local conditions. Please carry this voucher and a photo ID.
fields.helpText: Printed at the bottom of every excursion voucher.

fields.label: Confirming a service needs

options.label: A confirmation reference or an evidence file

fields.helpText: What the agent must enter in Confirm Service before a booking service can be Confirmed.

fields.label: Create the booking automatically once the quotation is accepted and paid
fields.helpText: On: the booking is made as soon as the accepted quotation is paid enough — the advance or the full amount, as set in Settings → General (Allow Booking Creation After Advance Payment). Off: use Create Booking on the quotation (the same payment rule applies).

fields.label: Vouchers only after full payment
fields.helpText: On: a hotel, transport or excursion voucher is issued only for a Confirmed service of a booking whose quotation is paid in full (verified payments).

fields.label: Allow completing a booking before the trip ends
fields.helpText: Off: Mark completed is possible once the travel end date has passed (in the workspace time zone).
